title: ulmus glabra var. scabra
intro: Ulmus glabra var. scabra, commonly known as the Wych Elm, is a deciduous tree native to Europe and Western Asia, characterized by its broad, flat leaves and smooth bark. The health benefits of Wych Elm include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various skin conditions and infections. The therapeutic actions of Ulmus glabra var. scabra include wound healing, astringency, and antiseptic properties, which help to protect and soothe the skin. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
